newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lung Kee year net rises 138 percent.
newsitem.headline: Lung Kee year net rises 138 percent.

text.p: Company name Lung Kee (Bermuda) Holdings Ltd
NOTE - Lung Kee makes mould bases.
The company proposed a special dividend of five H.K. cents per share and a bonus issue of one-for-four shares held.

The exceptional item represented the gain on disposal and deemed disposal of Lung Kee Metal Holdings Ltd (LKMH), a subsidiary of the group in a separate listing exercise. LKMH, the intermediate holding company of the group's mould base manufacturing business, was listed on the Stock Exchange of Singapore Ltd. LKMH offered 25 percent of the enlarged issued share capital of LKMH to the public in Singapore in January 1997 by way of new issue and offer for sale.
Comparative share earnings and final dividend have been adjusted for the one-for-four bonus issue in September 1996.
Total dividend for year is 23 H.K. cents (including interim dividend of six cents and special dividend).
